title: ATV Quad Power Racing 2 (USA)
comment: The game page's profile (web/host/assetsource.js reads it). ATV 2's module and files are built from the player's own retail disc, so derivedFromRetail is true and the only source is the player's own files: delivery's profile.js refuses any remote source, R2 prefix or manifest for such a profile.

messages.noXbe: There is no default.xbe in that folder. Choose the folder that contains default.xbe (the top folder of your ATV Quad Power Racing 2 disc copy).
messages.xbeSize: This doesn't look like ATV Quad Power Racing 2 (USA). Its default.xbe is {size} bytes; the retail USA release's is {want} bytes. Only that release is supported.
messages.xbeHash: This doesn't look like ATV Quad Power Racing 2 (USA). Its default.xbe has the right size but different contents (SHA-256 {sha}…), so it is another release or a modified copy. Only the retail USA release is supported.
messages.noArchives: default.xbe is the right one, but {missing} {verb} missing or empty. Copy the whole disc folder and choose it again.
messages.checked: default.xbe is the retail USA build
